ask: this is a mess sort it out lol
sentence: Tracks shared expenses for a group trip, splits the total equally, and shows the fewest payments needed so everyone is settled, with a way to mark payments as paid.
use_when: A group trip has many expenses paid by different people and nobody knows who owes what
Someone wants the total and each person's equal share worked out
The group wants the fewest payments to settle up
People need to add or remove what they paid and track who has paid back
dont_use_when: Costs should be split unevenly or by item, not equally
Only one person needs a single bill or tip calculated
The group wants a budget, a poll on spending, or a shared to-do list
